description: Reported financial values of a US-listed company from SEC XBRL company facts: the most recent annual (10-K) and quarterly (10-Q) figures for one concept such as revenue, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, cash or shares outstanding, with fiscal year, period dates, unit, form and filing date. Accepts friendly aliases or any us-gaap/dei concept name. Source: SEC EDGAR. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits

concept.description: Alias (revenue, net_income, eps, eps_basic, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, shares, operating_income, gross_profit, operating_cash_flow, rd, long_term_debt) or XBRL concept such as Assets or dei:EntityPublicFloat (default Revenues)

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. MSFT (ticker or cik is required)

name: sec_facts
title: sec_facts
